fields.name: time_suppression_complete

fields.name: time_primary_search_begin

fields.name: time_primary_search_complete
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.definition: Timestamp at which primary search operations are complete.
fields.comments: On an incident basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.

fields.name: time_water_on_fire

fields.name: time_fire_knocked_down

fields.name: time_extrication_complete

fields.name: unit_id_linked

fields.name: unit_id_reported
fields.definition: Name of the unit responding to the incident if not in FD Spec.

fields.name: unit_staffing_reported
fields.definition: On-scene staffing of unit.

fields.name: unit_unable_to_dispatch
fields.definition: Set to TRUE if unit is unable to dispatch.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. This can be from dispatch or completed in incident schema and designed to capture if unit cannot be dispatched (e.g., driver not available prevents unit from dispatching)

fields.name: unit_response_mode
fields.definition: Response mode of unit as part of the unit's response to an incident.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. This can be from dispatch or completed in incident schema.

fields.name: unit_dispatch_point
fields.definition: WGS84 latitude and longitude of unit.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis
fields.NERIS Validation Range: Valid latitude within XX miles of department boundary

fields.name: time_dispatch
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.definition: Timestamp that the unit is dispatched.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: Must not be null. Either valid timestamp.

fields.name: time_enroute_to_scene
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.definition: Timestamp that the unit goes enroute to scene of the incident.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: Must not be null. Either valid timestamp.

fields.name: time_on_scene
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.definition: Timestamp that the unit arrived on scene.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: Must not be null. Either valid timestamp.

fields.name: time_canceled_enroute
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.definition: Timestamp for units that were canceled prior to arrival.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis: Required if any units are cancelled en-route. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null, valid timestamp otherwise.

fields.name: time_staging
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.definition: Timestamp that the unit stages on scene.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null, valid timestamp otherwise.

fields.name: time_at_patient
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.definition: Timestamp that the provider reaches the patient's side.
fields.comments: On a per unit bais: If more than one patient. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null, valid timestamp otherwise.

fields.name: time_enroute_hospital
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.possible_if: dispatch_incident_type = MEDICAL and unit_unable_to_dispatch is FALSE
fields.definition: Timestamp that the unit statuses enroute to the hospital.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null, valid timestamp otherwise.

fields.name: time_arrived_hospital
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.possible_if: dispatch_incident_type = MEDICAL and unit_unable_to_dispatch is FALSE
fields.definition: Timestamp that the unit arrives at the hospital.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null, valid timestamp otherwise.

fields.name: hospital_destination
fields.possible_if: dispatch_incident_type = MEDICAL and unit_unable_to_dispatch is FALSE
fields.definition: Name of the hospital where the patient is transported.
fields.example: University of Maryland Capital Regional Medical Center
fields.comments: If medical
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null. Either valid timestamp.

fields.name: time_transfer_to_agency
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.possible_if: dispatch_incident_type = MEDICAL and unit_unable_to_dispatch is FALSE
fields.definition: Timestamp that the provider transfers care to a transporting agency.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null, valid timestamp otherwise.

fields.name: time_transfer_to_facility
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.possible_if: dispatch_incident_type = MEDICAL and unit_unable_to_dispatch is FALSE
fields.definition: Timestamp that the provider transfers care to a hospital or facility.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null, valid timestamp otherwise.

fields.name: time_hospital_clear
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.possible_if: dispatch_incident_type = MEDICAL and unit_unable_to_dispatch is FALSE
fields.definition: Timestamp that the unit clears the hospital.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: May be null, valid timestamp otherwise.

fields.name: time_unit_clear
fields.format: An ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with offset.
fields.definition: Timestamp that the unit clears the incident.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. In UTC: ISO 8601 formatted datetime string with 00:00 offset.
fields.NERIS Validation Range: Must not be null. Either valid timestamp.

fields.name: time_turnout
fields.definition: Time between dispatch time and en-route time.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis: enroute_time - dispatch_time

fields.name: time_travel
fields.definition: Time between en route time and on scene time.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis: onscene_time - enroute_time

fields.name: unit_transport_mode
fields.possible_if: time_enroute_hospital not null and unit_unable_to_dispatch is FALSE
fields.definition: Transport mode of unit as part of the unit's response to a hospital.
fields.comments: On a per unit basis. This can be from dispatch or completed in incident schema.
